The recruiter then creates a second contact from reviewed text, uploads a unique TXT conversation, reviews seven speaker-attributed fragments, confirms six exact-quote candidate facts, excludes recruiter and unknown lines from person state, compiles a 21-reference Wiki, retrieves the contact through People, and verifies duplicate, cancel, retry, keyboard, and 390-pixel responsive behavior.

review_plan.reason: The artifact changes the core screenshot and TXT-to-contact workflow, recruiter review burden, interruption cost, and People retrieval.
The artifact governs private image and text sources, speaker authority, identity, ambiguity, retention, fact confirmation, and deletion.
The final goal explicitly requires end-to-end UI review and the responsive 390-pixel relationship workflow is in scope.

No candidate-facing message, notification, autonomous communication, or external write is generated in the internal contact-management slice.

Independent human labels and provider-side lifecycle inspection remain pending.

agreements: All selected reviewers find the current internal screenshot/TXT-to-Wiki-to-People loop executable and directly evidenced.
All selected reviewers find no active safety, identity, unauthorized-write, inaccessible-path, or human-value-ranking veto in the reviewed scope.
All selected reviewers accept the 26-of-26 Playwright acceptance gate as a transparent browser-quality score, not a substitute for field or assistive evidence.

All selected reviewers retain score 2 because their separate rubrics require independent human, assistive, external-effect, provider-lifecycle, or field evidence that browser automation cannot manufacture.

disagreements.issue: Whether the explicit labeled-field TXT format should be broadened immediately to natural-language semantic extraction

positions.position: Broader natural-language extraction could reduce preparation burden if correction stays easy.
positions.evidence: The natural-language control created a source-only record, so a recruiter must use field labels for structured facts.

positions.position: The current conservative format prevents unsupported inference and should not be broadened without calibrated evidence.
positions.evidence: Only reviewed candidate-attributed labeled fields produced proposals; recruiter and unknown lines produced none.

disagreements.resolution: Keep the conservative compiler for this release and treat broader semantic extraction as a separately versioned, independently calibrated artifact with exact quotes and the same human gates.
disagreements.resolution_basis: The current path satisfies the internal loop without silent inference; convenience does not justify weakening the evidence boundary before calibration.

adjudication.rationale: The panel passes the internal relationship workspace with changes. The current production Chromium build proves live image analysis, explicit identity, ambiguity preservation, TXT upload, speaker and fragment review, candidate-only fact authority, six separately confirmed facts, durable Wiki compilation, exact People readback, duplicate prevention, No action, slow cancellation, retry, keyboard access, and zero horizontal overflow with zero console errors. The atomic Playwright gate is 26 of 26, or 100 percent. Specialist scores are not averaged or converted into a percentage; they remain 2 because independent human, assistive, provider-lifecycle, external-effect, and field evidence remain outside the artifact.
